scripts.host:build: SELF_HOSTED=1 node scripts/syncVersion.js && SELF_HOSTED=1 node scripts/buildPkg.js
scripts.host:sync: node scripts/syncVersion.js && NO_PACK=1 node scripts/buildPkg.js && node scripts/syncLocalAgent.mjs
scripts.host:publish: npm run host:build && cd host && npm publish
scripts.host:publish:local: npm run host:build && cd host && npm publish --registry http://localhost:4873
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=host && npm run typecheck --workspace=web && npm run typecheck --workspace=gitbook && npm run typecheck --workspace=desktop && npm run typecheck --prefix expo
scripts.docs:deploy: npm run build --workspace=gitbook && cd gitbook && npx wrangler pages deploy out --project-name=9remote-docs
scripts._pc:tauri: NINEREMOTE_ENV=development npm run tauri dev --prefix desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=host && npm run test --workspace=web
